category: Usenet indexer (Newznab API, successor to NZB.su)

free_tier.stated: Not stated on the pages reachable. caps declares <limits max="100" default="100"/> and <registration available="yes" open="yes"/>; /register serves a Create Account form with password rules and no invite field.
free_tier.notes: unit is recorded as none because no allowance is published; A third-party table claims the old NZB.su free tier gave '0 calls' and that VIP was USD 9 for 180 days and USD 15 for 360 days.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file

retention.stated: not published on the pages read; a third-party table claims 'over 2,000 days of binary retention, 50 newsgroups indexed' for the old name.

egress.terms: No byte metering observed; the API returns pointers.

interface_detail: Newznab API at /api (caps title still reads 'NZB.su', so the software was renamed but not the server string), 100 results per request. Registration is a plain form on the site.
tooling: Native Newznab: change the host in an existing NZB.su entry and the key keeps working, per the vendor's own error message. Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 need nothing else.
chaining: The live successor under the old NZB.su key, so an existing stack recovers by editing one URL.

limits.value: registration open, but the allowance is only visible after login

binding_note: No counter could be read without an account, so naming one would be a guess. The 100-result cap is real and measured in caps; it is a per-request result ceiling, not a rate.

identity_cost.detail: Open registration: /register serves Create Account with a 10-character password policy and no invite or card field.

reliability_note: The caps still announces itself as 'NZB.su' with email [address removed], so tools that key on the server title will show the old name and look mis-configured.
confidence_note: caps and the registration form were read. The allowance is unstated, which is why the verdict is a caveat.

evidence.proved: caps returned 200 and 226,097 bytes: title 'NZB.su', <limits max="100" default="100"/>, <registration available="yes" open="yes"/>
Create Account form with password rules (10+ characters, one uppercase, one number, one special), no invite field
third-party for the old name: 'VIP 180-day USD 9, 360-day USD 15', free tier '0 calls'

extras.price: USD 15/360 days (reported, under the old name)
